title: Quick Buttery Egyptian Tahini Pasta
description: A creamy and buttery Egyptian dish featuring tahini and bonito flakes, perfect for a quick dinner, and can be made dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt the vegan butter over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the bonito flakes and cook for 1 minute until lightly toasted.
In a blender or food processor, combine the tahini, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet with the garlic and bonito flakes, and toss to combine.
Pour the tahini sauce over the pasta and toss to coat.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with chopped parsley.
